oop_01.title: The Mold of Objects
oop_01.prompt: In Object-Oriented Programming, which word do we use to create the "mold" or "blueprint" of an object?
oop_01.explanation: A "class" is like a cookie cutter! It defines the shape and recipe, and the objects are the finished cookies.

oop_02.title: The Magic Constructor
oop_02.prompt: The special method that initializes an object when it is born is called `__init__`. Complete the required parameter representing the object itself:
oop_02.explanation: self means "myself"! That's how the object knows what its own features and attributes are.

oop_03.title: Creating a Virtual Pet
oop_03.prompt: Order the code to define the `Pet` class and create a dog named "Rex":
oop_03.explanation: Creating an object from a class is called "instantiation". meu_pet is now a real object!

oop_04.title: The Robot that Introduces Itself
oop_04.prompt: Create a `Robo` class that receives `nome` in `__init__` and has a `falar()` method returning `"Eu sou o robô " + self.nome`. Create a function `testar_robo(nome)` that returns this greeting!
oop_04.explanation: Methods are functions created inside the class that give superpowers and actions to the object!

boss_battle_14.title: The Steel Titan
boss_battle_14.prompt: Create a `Guerreiro` class with `__init__(self, ataque)` and create the object `g = Guerreiro(50)`. Display `g.ataque`!
boss_battle_14.explanation: The Titan demands that you build your own Warrior using Object Orientation!
